vehicleRules.vehicle: 1 x MPV, e.g. Toyota Avanza or similar
1 x Toyota Hiace or similar 16-seat minibus
1 x Toyota Hiace + 1 x MPV for seating and luggage space

bromoJeepRule.rule: Private jeep(s) for sunrise and crater viewpoints; max about 4 guests per jeep for comfort and safety.

roomingRules: Even-numbered groups: 1 room per 2 guests, king or twin.
Odd-numbered groups: 1 room per 2 guests plus 1 extra bed in one room.
Maximum 2 guests per standard room, excluding designated extra bed.
Separate rooms or extra rooms can be requested subject to confirmation and supplement.
note: Vehicle source text differs slightly between travel guide and policy for 1-3 vs 2-3 guests; product contract should resolve the canonical rule.
